_what: Sample BYOK (bring-your-own-key) connections — YOUR OWN provider account/subscription. The key is NEVER stored in the company definition or an export: connections reference an ENV VAR NAME (apiKeyEnv), and you set that env var locally. Your key stays on your machine.
_setup: export USER_OWN_ANTHROPIC_KEY=sk-...   (or your provider's key) before starting the app.
